items.title: Patient Workflows
items.note: Salam, / Context: Full Smile Dental meeting 7 / 30 identified multiple patient communication workflow gaps. Current GHL setup lacks instant form-reply SMS, appointment confirmation / reminder automation, review request triggers, and proper lead routing from Google / LSA into Opportunities. They also use Open Dental with specific status indicator conventions (Green = confirmed appointment, Yellow = sent) that need to sync back from GHL confirmation workflows. / Deliverable 1 – Instant Form Reply: Reactivate immediate SMS response when patient submits a form (was previously active, now disabled or broken). Trigger should fire instantly on form submission, welcoming the patient and setting follow-up expectations. / Deliverable 2 – Appointment Confirmation SMS: Build two-stage reminder system: 2-day advance reminder and 2-hour day-of reminder. Both must accept reply logic for confirm (C) or cancel (X), replicating the exact behavior Full Smile had with Flex Dental. Confirmed appointments need to mark the patient record accordingly. / Deliverable 3 – Review Request Automation: Add a trigger to the GHL Opportunity pipeline that sends a review request post-appointment. Target outcome is 30+ reviews per month. Trigger point and messaging TBD (likely after appointment marked complete or won). / Deliverable 4 – Lead Call Routing: Route inbound calls from Google and LSA lead campaigns directly into GHL Opportunities (not just contacts). Ensures proper pipeline tracking and follow-up automation from first touch. / Deliverable 5 – Open Dental Status Sync: Figure out how to sync GHL appointment confirmation status back to Open Dental's color-coded status indicators: Green = confirmed appointment, Yellow = sent (reminder sent, not yet confirmed). This likely requires API integration or webhook between GHL and Open Dental to update appointment status fields in real time. / Dependencies: Confirm Full Smile's existing GHL account structure, Opportunity pipeline stages, and Open Dental API access / credentials before starting the status sync work. Form-reply and appointment reminders can proceed immediately if GHL infrastructure is already live. / Done: Instant form-reply fires on every form submission, 2-day and 2-hour appointment reminders send with working C / X reply logic, review requests trigger automatically post-appointment and generate 30+ reviews / month, Google / LSA calls create Opportunities in GHL, and confirmed appointments in GHL update Open Dental status to Green (Yellow for sent-but-not-confirmed). / Assignment note: Transcript named Sohib Boundaoui directly as the builder for this workflow suite. CRM board defaults to Ahmed Memon + Ali Shaheer. Naz tagged to confirm whether Sohib should be explicitly assigned or if this stays with the CRM team. / @Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer @Nacer Amrouch / Assigned to: Ahmed Memon, Ali Shaheer, Nacer Amrouch

• Instant Form Reply: Reactivate immediate SMS response when patient submits a form (was previously active, now disabled or broken). Trigger should fire instantly on form submission, welcoming the patient and setting follow-up expectations.

Both must accept reply logic for confirm (C) or cancel (X), replicating the exact behavior Full Smile had with Flex Dental. Confirmed appointments need to mark the patient record accordingly. items.title: Sync Open Dental claim payments into GHL on "Received" status
items.note: Salam, / Context: Full Smile's marketing dashboard needs to distinguish real insurance payments from estimates to calculate accurate ROI. Open Dental does not offer webhooks for claim status changes, so this requires building a custom polling pipeline on the Flow DigitalOcean Droplet that monitors when claims hit "Received" status and syncs the actual payment data into GHL. Payment tracking inherently lags Open Dental by approximately 1 month due to insurance processing timelines. / Technical scope: Build a full poll-and-relay integration that (1) polls Open Dental's API for claims marked "Received," (2) fetches detailed claimproc and claimpayment data via the endpoints documented at https: / / www.opendental.com / site / apiclaimprocs.html and https: / / www.opendental.com / site / apiclaimpayments.html, (3) formats and pushes that payment data into GHL to trigger downstream workflows, (4) maintains a "last checked" timestamp to avoid duplicate processing, and (5) includes retry logic and logging for reliability. / Execution sequence: (1) Build the poller script on the Droplet, (2) implement fetch logic for claimproc and claimpayment detail from Open Dental's API, (3) format the payload and send to GHL, (4) track "last checked" state persistently, (5) add retry / error handling and logging to monitor ongoing syncs. / Dependencies: Requires Open Dental API credentials for Full Smile (confirm these are already available), GHL webhook endpoint or custom field target for receiving payment data (confirm the exact destination in GHL), and Droplet access / deployment permissions. Do not start until API credentials and GHL target endpoint are confirmed. / Done: Real claim payment data flows automatically from Open Dental into GHL when claims reach "Received" status, the patient value column in the marketing dashboard reflects accurate payment amounts (not estimates), retry / logging is live and monitoring the pipeline, and the sync runs reliably without manual intervention. / @Ali Shaheer @Ahmed Memon / Assigned to: Ahmed Memon, Ali Shaheer

payload.itemName: Sync Open Dental claim payments into GHL on "Received" status
payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • Context: Full Smile's marketing dashboard needs to distinguish real insurance payments from estimates to calculate accurate ROI. Open Dental does not offer webhooks for claim status changes, so this requires building a custom polling pipeline on the Flow DigitalOcean Droplet that monitors when claims hit "Received" status and syncs the actual payment data into GHL. Payment tracking inherently lags Open Dental by approximately 1 month due to insurance processing timelines.
  • Technical scope: Build a full poll-and-relay integration that (1) polls Open Dental's API for claims marked "Received," (2) fetches detailed claimproc and claimpayment data via the endpoints documented at https://www.opendental.com/site/apiclaimprocs.html and https://www.opendental.com/site/apiclaimpayments.html, (3) formats and pushes that payment data into GHL to trigger downstream workflows, (4) maintains a "last checked" timestamp to avoid duplicate processing, and (5) includes retry logic and logging for reliability.
  • Execution sequence: (1) Build the poller script on the Droplet, (2) implement fetch logic for claimproc and claimpayment detail from Open Dental's API, (3) format the payload and send to GHL, (4) track "last checked" state persistently, (5) add retry/error handling and logging to monitor ongoing syncs.
  • Dependencies: Requires Open Dental API credentials for Full Smile (confirm these are already available), GHL webhook endpoint or custom field target for receiving payment data (confirm the exact destination in GHL), and Droplet access/deployment permissions. Do not start until API credentials and GHL target endpoint are confirmed.
  • Done: Real claim payment data flows automatically from Open Dental into GHL when claims reach "Received" status, the patient value column in the marketing dashboard reflects accurate payment amounts (not estimates), retry/logging is live and monitoring the pipeline, and the sync runs reliably without manual intervention.

@Ali Shaheer @Ahmed Memon
